heading: What comes in, and what you own.
introEdit: Your regular income, and the money and things of value you own: bank accounts, crypto, stocks, property. Fixed bills and category limits are on the Spending page.
introView: Regular income and what the household owns. Only owners and editors can change them.

categoriesPage.heading: Monthly limits and fixed bills.
categoriesPage.introEdit: The categories you log expenses under, with a monthly limit, and the bills that come back every month, week or year. Archive categories you don't use: past expenses keep them.
categoriesPage.introView: Expense categories with their monthly limits, and the fixed bills. Only owners and editors can change them.

recurring.title: Recurring income and bills
recurring.subtitle: Amounts that repeat. Weekly and yearly items are converted to a monthly average.
recurring.incomeSubtitle: Salary and any other regular income.
recurring.billsSubtitle: Rent, utilities, subscriptions: costs you expect every time. Pick the category you'd log the payment under, so logging it too doesn't count it twice.

categories.title: Categories and monthly limits
categories.subtitle: Used to group expenses. Set a limit to see how close you are on the dashboard.
categories.confirmDelete: Delete {name} for good? Bills in this category will be left without one. Categories with expenses can only be archived.

errors.generic: Something went wrong. Refresh the page and try again.
errors.amount: Enter an amount above zero, e.g. 1250 or 12.50.
errors.limit: Enter an amount, e.g. 300, or leave it empty for no limit.
errors.categoryExists: A category with this name already exists (it may be archived).
errors.categoryInUse: {name} has expenses logged under it, so it can't be deleted. Archive it instead: past expenses keep it.
errors.assetGone: This no longer exists. Refresh the page.

assets.title: What you own
assets.subtitle: Bank accounts, crypto, stocks, property. Update the values now and then; together they make your net worth.
assets.name: Name
